subject: SummitBridge integration: request for consolidated SLA & escalation path
messages:
From: Asha Raman <asha.raman@summitbridge.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Keller <tom.keller@summitbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intermittent webhook timeouts + escalation coverage request

Hi Olga,

We surfaced intermittent webhook timeouts from the SummitBridge-managed connectors to Redwood over the past 48 hours. A subset of our mutual customers (three production tenants) saw failed deliveries and retries that caused downstream job backlogs. Our internal engineers traced the first failed deliveries to timeouts between 02:20–03:05 UTC on Jun 1; most retries recovered but two customers required manual reconciliation.

Can you confirm Redwood's escalation path for partner-integrated incidents? Our customers are asking for one consolidated SLA for the SummitBridge-Redwood integration (we want consistent triage and response steps across accounts) and a single POC for fast escalation.

Attached: brief log bundle and a short timeline (integration-logs-20270601.zip). We also have an initial SLA proposal that we can share if helpful.

Asking:
- Who should SummitBridge call for urgent on-call escalation?
- Can Redwood commit to a partner-level initial response window so we can communicate to customers?
- Any recommended next steps for preventing recurrence?

Thanks,
Asha Raman
Partnerships Lead, SummitBridge Consulting
asha.raman@summitbridge.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0132

---
(Attachment: integration-logs-20270601.zip)
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Raman <asha.raman@summitbridge.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent webhook timeouts + escalation coverage request

Hi Asha — thanks for the heads up and for sending the logs. I'm sorry for the interruption to your customers.

Short answers up front:
- Dedicated partner escalation POC: we can set that up (proposed: partnerships-oncall@redwoodinference.com + PagerDuty integration).
- Initial response window: we can commit to a consolidated partner-level initial response time; I'll propose options below after we triage the logs.

I'll loop in Sergio (Platform Ops) and Marissa (Customer Success) to validate the traces and recommend a temporary runbook while we agree on a formal SLA. Can you attach the SLA proposal you mentioned? If you can include any customer IDs and the webhook delivery payload samples (redact PII) that will speed diagnosis.

I'll follow up with a proposed escalation flow and a draft runbook by EOD.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com
(Attachment requested: summitbridge-sla-proposal.pdf)

---
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SummitBridge webhook failures — quick coordination and proposed actions

Team — forwarding Asha's note and logs. Quick plan and asks so we can move fast:

1) Triage (Sergio)
- Can you validate whether the timeouts originated at our edge LB, model-serving tier, or a transient network hiccup between our region and SummitBridge? Use the attached logs and correlate with infra traces between 02:00–04:00 UTC.
- If infra shows an internal delay > 500ms on the webhook ack path, escalate to infra on-call.

2) Runbook & SLA (Marissa + Olga)
- I propose we offer SummitBridge a partner-level SLA: initial triage acknowledgement within 1 hour for P1 incidents, 4-hour acknowledgement for P2, and a P1 mitigation target of 4 hours to restore service or failover.
- We should produce a short 'partner runbook' doc (redwood-runbook-sla.md) that lists POC, escalation steps, temporary mitigations (replay hooks, restart consumer), and communication templates.

3) Commercial/contract (Ben)
- Ben, can you confirm if a partner-level SLA extension needs an amendment or if we can provide an operational commitment via a partner addendum? SummitBridge is asking for one consolidated SLA across joint production tenants.

4) Communications
- If this is a joint-prod P1, we should create a dedicated Slack channel (#sb-redwood-integrations) and add SummitBridge POCs + our on-call. Also propose a shared PagerDuty integration.

Attachments I'm preparing: temporary runbook draft (redwood-runbook-sla.md). I will draft and share a one-page SLA addendum to review with Ben.

Thanks — hoping we can deliver the runbook by EOD for Asha to circulate.

Olga
Partnerships Manager
From: Asha Raman <asha.raman@summitbridge.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Keller <tom.keller@summitbridge.com>, support@summitbridge.com
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent webhook timeouts + escalation coverage request

Hi Olga — thanks for the quick reply and for looping in the right folks. We've attached the SLA proposal (summitbridge-sla-proposal.pdf) and the zipped logs you requested. Couple notes from our side:

- Customer IDs included in the logs: SB-CUST-218, SB-CUST-312, SB-CUST-407. Payload samples are redacted as requested.
- Our proposal calls for a 1-hour initial response for P1 incidents and a 2-hour mitigation window for critical customer-impacting failures; we understand some mitigation may require coordination and want to be realistic about restore targets.
- We are open to a shared PagerDuty integration and a Slack escalation channel. We prefer a named Redwood POC + an on-call rotation.

Requests:
- Can you confirm whether Redwood will accept a partner-level 1-hour initial response for P1s, and if so, whether that is an operational SLA (runbook + tooling) or a contractual addendum?
- Please confirm a POC and which on-call team will handle infra-level escalations.

Appreciate the collaboration.

Thanks,
Asha Raman
(Attachment: summitbridge-sla-proposal.pdf; Attachment: integration-logs-20270601.zip)
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Raman <asha.raman@summitbridge.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Intermittent webhook timeouts + escalation coverage request

Asha — thank you and appreciate the detail in your proposal. Summary of what Redwood can commit to operationally and next steps:

Agreed operational commitments (partner-level):
- Initial response: 1 hour for P1 incidents (partner-defined P1 affecting joint-production customers). This is an operational commitment (runbook + tooling); Ben will advise on contract wording if SummitBridge wants to convert to a contractual SLA addendum.
- Mitigation target: we will aim for a 4-hour mitigation for P1s where a soft failover or replay can restore service; some restores requiring code changes will follow normal incident pipelines.
- Escalation flow: initial triage by Partnerships/CS (Marissa) -> Platform Ops (Sergio) -> Infra on-call (via PagerDuty) if infra root cause detected. If PagerDuty escalation is necessary, infra will be paged after 15 minutes without mitigation progress.

Operational items we will deliver by EOD Jun 4:
- Partner runbook (redwood-runbook-sla.md) with playbooks for replay, temporary throttles, and contact lists.
- Shared Slack channel: #sb-redwood-integrations (we'll invite SummitBridge POCs).
- PagerDuty integration and a shared escalation schedule (will share PD integration link).
- JIRA ticket for the incident/reconciliations: JIRA-INC-1247 (we'll attach logs and action items).

Commercial step: Ben will follow up on whether a formal addendum is required for the contractual SLA. Operationally we can proceed once SummitBridge confirms the POC list and approves the runbook.

Asha, can you confirm the POC names and phone numbers you want added to the Slack channel and PagerDuty rotation? Once we have that we will create the channel and PD escalation and send calendar invites for a 30-minute runbook review.

Attachments: redwood-runbook-sla.md (draft), link to drive folder with incident traces: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDEF-summitbridge-runbooks

Olga Petrov
Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 650-555-0199
(Attachments: redwood-runbook-sla.md, JIRA-INC-1247)
